title: China-to-Luxembourg BESS Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Luxembourg adopts EU harmonised standards. BESS installations must demonstrate thermal runaway propagation prevention per IEC 62933-5-2:2020 (EN IEC 62933-5-2) and UL 9540A (5th Ed, March 2025; 6th Ed published March 2026) for system-level fire spread data required by Luxembourg fire authority (Corps Grand-Ducal d'Incendie et de Secours, CGDIS) and building permits.
rows.china_equivalent: GB/T 36276-2023 (in force 1 March 2024) covers Li-ion battery safety for BESS. GB/T 51048-2025 (effective 1 April 2026) covers BESS engineering technical standards. Neither provides IEC 62933-5-2 Annex C system-level propagation data or UL 9540A HRR/fire-spread data.
rows.gap: Chinese test reports under GB/T 36276 lack IEC 62933-5-2 Annex C system-level propagation data and UL 9540A HRR/fire-spread data required by Luxembourg CGDIS and EU AHJs for building permits and insurance.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for building permit and insurance in Luxembourg
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 36276-2023 mandatory for grid-connected BESS projects in China

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Supplementary testing to IEC 62933-5-2 and UL 9540A is required for Luxembourg market entry. Chinese GB/T 36276 reports are insufficient for CGDIS building permits and EU insurer acceptance.

source.publisher: ILNAS — Luxembourg Institute for Standardisation, Accreditation, Safety and Metrology

rows.requirement: Grid Connection for BESS PCS/Storage Inverter
rows.target_requirement: Luxembourg grid operator Creos requires compliance with EN 50549-1:2019 (micro/small generators ≤800 W) and EN 50549-2:2019 (generators >800 W), Commission Regulation (EU) 2016/631 (RfG Network Code), and applicable VDE-AR-N application rules. Luxembourg operates at 230/400 V 50 Hz. ILR oversees energy market regulation.
rows.china_equivalent: GB/T 34120-2023 (supersedes 2017; includes LVRT/HVRT) and GB/T 19964-2024 govern grid connection for Chinese BESS. Q/GDW 1564-2014 covers State Grid BESS technical requirements. China grid operates at 220/380 V 50 Hz.
rows.gap: GB/T 34120 is not accepted as EN 50549 equivalent by Creos or ILR. Key differences: voltage window (230/400 V vs 220/380 V), V/F ride-through curves, Q(U) reactive power curves, reconnection delays, and communications protocol (IEC 61850 vs Modbus/CAN). Full re-testing and Creos grid-connection application required.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — Creos grid connection approval required before commissioning
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 34120-2023 mandatory for Chinese grid-connected BESS

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Full re-testing to EN 50549-1/-2 and formal Creos grid-connection application are required before any Luxembourg BESS commissioning. GB/T 34120 reports are not substitutable.

source.publisher: Creos Luxembourg S.A. — Luxembourg Grid Operator

rows.target_requirement: Luxembourg applies EU harmonised standards under LVD 2014/35/EU. Industrial Li-ion batteries for BESS must comply with EN IEC 62619:2022 (safety requirements for secondary Li-ion cells/batteries for use in industrial applications) and EN IEC 63056:2020 (secondary Li-ion cells/batteries for use in electrical energy storage systems). EU Declaration of Conformity (DoC) and technical file required.
rows.china_equivalent: GB/T 36276-2023 (recommended, widely adopted) and GB 44240-2024 (compulsory for electric energy storage products) cover Li-ion battery safety in China. Nail penetration conditions, thermal runaway propagation (Annex C), and BMS functional safety depth differ from EN IEC 62619/63056.
rows.gap: Chinese test reports (GB/T 36276, GB 44240) are not substitutable for EU DoC + technical file under LVD. Nail penetration test conditions, thermal runaway propagation data (Annex C), and BMS functional safety evidence must be re-established against EN IEC 62619/63056. No bilateral MRA between China and Luxembourg/EU for battery safety certification.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — LVD CE marking required for Luxembourg/EU market
mandatory_status.cn: GB 44240-2024 mandatory; GB/T 36276-2023 widely required by State Grid/CSG

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Chinese battery safety reports are not accepted as EU DoC/technical file substitutes. Full re-testing to EN IEC 62619:2022 and EN IEC 63056:2020 is required for Luxembourg market entry under LVD.

source.publisher: ILNAS — Luxembourg Institute for Standardisation, Accreditation, Safety and Metrology

rows.target_requirement: System-level BESS safety in Luxembourg/EU is governed by IEC 62933-5-2:2020 (BESS safety requirements), EN IEC 62040-1:2019 (UPS safety), LVD 2014/35/EU, and EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542. Battery passport (digital product passport) mandatory from 18 February 2027 for industrial batteries ≥2 kWh. Due diligence, carbon footprint, and supply-chain documentation required under Battery Regulation.
rows.china_equivalent: GB/T 36558-2023 (system-level, effectively mandatory for State Grid/CSG projects) covers BESS system safety. GB/T 34131-2023 covers BMS requirements. No Chinese standard is equivalent to IEC 62933-5-2 Annex B thermal runaway propagation prevention or EU Battery Regulation battery passport requirements.
rows.gap: No Chinese standard equivalent to IEC 62933-5-2 Annex B thermal runaway propagation prevention. EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 due-diligence, carbon footprint declaration, and battery passport requirements are entirely absent from Chinese regulatory framework. Battery passport mandatory from 18 February 2027 for industrial batteries ≥2 kWh.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 and LVD applicable in Luxembourg
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 36558-2023 effectively mandatory for State Grid/CSG projects

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 imposes battery passport, due diligence, and carbon footprint obligations with no Chinese equivalent. Manufacturers must prepare for battery passport compliance before 18 February 2027.

source.publisher: ILNAS — Luxembourg Institute for Standardisation, Accreditation, Safety and Metrology

rows.target_requirement: All BESS placed on the Luxembourg/EU market must comply with LVD 2014/35/EU (electrical equipment designed for use within certain voltage limits). Manufacturer must hold EU Declaration of Conformity (DoC) and technical file; affix CE marking; appoint EU Authorised Representative if no EU establishment. French and German language instructions are required for Luxembourg market.
rows.china_equivalent: GB 44240-2024 (compulsory for electric energy storage), GB/T 36276-2023, and GB/T 36558-2023 cover electrical safety in China. Stationary BESS is not in CCC scope as of mid-2026 per available information (verify with CNCA). Chinese project-approval model does not produce product-level EU DoC/technical file.
rows.gap: Chinese project-approval model does not produce product-level EU DoC or technical file. No bilateral MRA between China and Luxembourg/EU. EU Authorised Representative must be appointed before first shipment. French and German language documentation required for Luxembourg market.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — CE marking under LVD required for Luxembourg/EU market placement
mandatory_status.cn: GB 44240-2024 mandatory for electric energy storage products sold in China

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU is mandatory for BESS in Luxembourg. An EU Authorised Representative must be appointed. French and German language instructions are expected for the Luxembourg market.

source.publisher: ILNAS — Luxembourg Institute for Standardisation, Accreditation, Safety and Metrology

rows.requirement: UN 38.3 Lithium Battery Transport Safety Testing
rows.target_requirement: Lithium batteries shipped to Luxembourg must comply with UN 38.3 Rev.8 (2023) + Amendment 1 (2025), UN 3480/3481, ADR 2025 (road transport via Antwerp/Rotterdam and overland through Belgium/France to Luxembourg), IMDG 41-22 (sea), and IATA DGR 65th Ed 2024. Luxembourg is landlocked — sea shipments route via Antwerp or Rotterdam, then overland by road/rail (ADR/RID apply).
rows.china_equivalent: UN 38.3 is adopted for export. GB 15599 (road, verify current edition via open sources), JT/T 617 (road DG), and CAAC DGR (IATA-aligned, air) govern Chinese domestic transport. Multimodal documentation must be rebuilt at EU entry port (Antwerp/Rotterdam) for onward ADR/RID overland leg to Luxembourg.
rows.gap: Luxembourg is landlocked — sea shipments via Antwerp/Rotterdam require IMDG compliance, then re-documentation for ADR 2025 overland leg. ADR 2025 SOC ≤30% and packaging provisions for large-format cells may not be in Chinese SOPs. EU member-state prior notification for large BESS road shipments. Full T1–T8 UN 38.3 test summary required (not just certificate).

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — ADR 2025 and IMDG 41-22 apply to all Luxembourg-bound BESS shipments
mandatory_status.cn: UN 38.3 mandatory for export; JT/T 617 for domestic road

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Luxembourg's landlocked position requires multimodal compliance: IMDG for sea leg (via Antwerp/Rotterdam), ADR 2025 for overland leg, and RID if rail. Re-documentation at EU entry port is mandatory. Engage a certified DGSA before first shipment.

source.publisher: ILNAS — Luxembourg Institute for Standardisation, Accreditation, Safety and Metrology

rows.target_requirement: ADR 2025 Ch.3.3 SP 377/188/230; IMDG 41-22; IATA DGR 65th Ed PI 965/966/967; CLP Regulation 1272/2008. DGSA (Dangerous Goods Safety Adviser) appointment mandatory for Luxembourg road DG transport operators. Class 9 lithium battery mark required. Large-energy BESS consignments require EU member-state prior notification.
rows.china_equivalent: JT/T 617.1-2018, JT/T 617.4-2018, GB 12463, CAAC DGR, and GACC inspection requirements govern Chinese DG transport and export. Multimodal re-documentation at EU entry port (Antwerp/Rotterdam) is required for Luxembourg-bound shipments.
rows.gap: DGSA appointment mandatory for EU/Luxembourg DG road transport. Class 9 lithium battery mark (IEC 62133-format) required on packages. ADR 2025/IMDG 41-22 updated provisions for large-energy consignments. Multimodal re-documentation required at Antwerp/Rotterdam before overland ADR/RID leg to Luxembourg.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — DGSA required for Luxembourg DG road transport operators; ADR/RID mandatory for overland leg
mandatory_status.cn: JT/T 617 mandatory for domestic road DG; GACC inspection for export

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Engage a certified DGSA and specialist DG freight forwarder before first shipment to Luxembourg. Multimodal re-documentation at Antwerp/Rotterdam is mandatory. DGSA appointment is required for the Luxembourg overland leg.

source.publisher: ILNAS — Luxembourg Institute for Standardisation, Accreditation, Safety and Metrology
